groups.description:
Maps, data, and reports with information about each publicly available redistricting proposal are available within this directory. At a minimum, each plan dataset includes the following files for download (using PLANC2100 as an example):

* PLANC2100.pdf - Statewide district map
* PLANC2100r100.pdf - District Population Analysis with County Subtotals report
* PLANC2100r202.pdf - Population and Voter Data with Voter Registration Comparison report
* PLANC2100.zip - Shapefile (.shp) of the plan in a compressed file (.zip) format
*  PLANC2100_blk.zip - Comma-separated values file (.csv) relating 2020 Census Blocks with districts in a compressed file (.zip) format

Redistricting plans are also made viewable on the interactive [_DistrictViewer_](https://dvr.capitol.texas.gov/) website.
